guides.intro: What a Shadow priest presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Shadow levels on a small mana budget: one damage-over-time spell, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, and the wand for everything else until **Mind Flay** arrives at 20. The spec comes alive at 40 with **Shadowform**. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Smite, until you own a wand
stages.change: **Smite** is your only attack. Buy or beg a wand as early as you can.
press: **Smite** until the mob is dead.
Once you own a wand: wand the mob down instead. It costs no mana, and it is how a priest levels until 20.
notes: Keep **Power Word: Fortitude** on yourself at all times, from here to 60.
The fight lab assumes a wand from level 1 and never casts **Smite**, so these levels are not simulated as you will play them.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Pain
stages.change: **Shadow Word: Pain** at the pull, then the wand. One cast per mob.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull.
Wand until the mob is dead.
notes: **Power Word: Shield** (6): cast it before a pull you start below half your health, not every pull.
**Renew** (8) heals you between fights for less mana than **Lesser Heal**.
Stop casting **Smite**. The tuned rotation never uses it: the wand is free and the mana buys more as **Shadow Word: Pain**.

stages.title: Mind Blast, and talents begin
stages.change: **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready. Talent points start with **Spirit Tap**.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready.
Wand between casts, and to finish.
stages.if_hurt: **Power Word: Shield** before a pull you start below half your health.
notes: **Spirit Tap** (10-14) returns mana after every kill. It is why you rarely drink.
**Inner Fire** (12) joins **Power Word: Fortitude** as a buff you always keep up.
**Psychic Scream** (14): when a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health, fear it and heal.
**Holy Fire** (20) is not part of the Shadow rotation, and **Starshards** (10, Night Elf only) is not either.

Racial spells in the list above: Divine Grace (Human), Desperate Prayer (Dwarf), Starshards (Night Elf), Confounding Flash (Gnome), Touch of Weakness (Undead), Hex of Weakness (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Mind Flay
stages.change: **Mind Flay** (talent) replaces most of your wanding: a channel that also slows the mob.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready.
**Mind Flay** in between. It slows the mob while you channel.
Your wand finishes a mob with a hit or two left.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health: **Flash Heal**. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%. **Power Word: Shield** before a pull you start below half your health.
notes: **Devouring Plague** (20): leave it off your bar. The tuned rotation never casts it: it costs too much mana for what it does before the mob dies.
**Improved Mind Blast** (24, 31-34) shortens the cooldown, so **Mind Blast** comes round more often as you level.

Racial spells in the list above: Feedback (Human), Chastise (Dwarf), Elune's Grace (Night Elf), Contingency Plan (Gnome), Dark Sacrifice (Undead), Shadowguard (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Death
stages.change: **Shadow Word: Death**, an instant finisher. **Early Demise** (35) adds crit chance to it on a mob at or below 20% health.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready.
**Shadow Word: Death** when one cast will kill the mob.
**Mind Flay** in between.
Your wand finishes a mob with a hit or two left.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health: **Flash Heal**. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%. **Power Word: Shield** before a pull you start below half your health.
notes: **Early Demise** (35) adds 15% critical strike chance to **Shadow Word: Death** on a mob at or below 20% of its health. It does not unlock a cast: the spell was always castable. The fight lab casts it there too.
**Shadow Word: Death** hurts you for 30% of your maximum health when the mob survives it. Keep it for the finish.

stages.title: Vampiric Embrace, then Shadowform
stages.change: **Vampiric Embrace** (talent, 39) opens the pull and heals you as you deal damage. **Shadowform** (talent, 40) stays on for good.
press: Pull with the instants: **Vampiric Embrace** when it is ready, then **Shadow Word: Pain**.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready.
**Shadow Word: Death** when one cast will kill the mob, or on a mob at or below 20% of its health (**Early Demise** adds crit there; if the mob survives you take the backlash).
**Mind Flay** in between.
Your wand finishes a mob with a hit or two left.
stages.if_hurt: **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health. At 39, before Shadowform, a **Flash Heal** below a third.
notes: **Shadowform** at 40 is the biggest jump of the whole climb: the fight lab's time per kill drops by more than a third. Never leave it.
In **Shadowform** you cannot cast Holy spells. Eat or bandage between fights instead of healing yourself.

The remaining points: **Darkness** (41-42) and **Dark Inspiration** (43-44), then mana: **Twin Disciplines** (45-49), **Twilight Focus** (50-52), **Mental Strength** (53-55), **Power in Light** (56-57, which this rotation never uses) and **Meditation** (58-60).

between: Drink only when you are below about 15% of your mana. **Spirit Tap** and the wand keep you going.
Eat when you are below 40% of your health. Before **Shadowform**, a **Renew** on yourself does the same for a little mana.
Recast **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** when they run out.
Visit the trainer every even level, and replace your wand whenever a better one turns up: it is half your damage before 20.
other: Discipline and Holy have their own leveling pages in this folder, for a priest who wants to arrive at 60 as a healer, and Smite is a damage build on their talents. All three are slower per kill.
Shadow is the fastest priest leveler at every level the fight lab simulates (20 to 60). Before 20 the wand does most of the work in every spec.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; buffs, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the escape or the save, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand, the Shift bar the wider or rarer version of the key under it. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup: the [priest keybinds page](keybinds.md).

slots.role: Control: fear what is on you
The panic heal, on a long cooldown (a Dwarf's spell)
The wand: your filler before 20, the finisher after

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift

slots.role: Strip a mob's buff or your debuff

notes: Q changes twice on bar 1: **Smite** until you own a wand, free from 4 (the tuned rotation stops casting it), then **Mind Flay** at 20.
No key: **Power Word: Fortitude**, **Inner Fire**, **Shadowform** (a click once, it stays on), **Renew** (a between-fights heal before 40), food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone.
Levels 1-3 fight with Q and the middle mouse button. From 4, Mouse 4 and the middle mouse button: the wand is your filler until 20.
**Devouring Plague** and **Holy Fire** are never cast by the tuned rotation: no key.

guides.intro: What a Discipline priest presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. This build is the Discipline raid healer's (29/22/0): it levels as a damage priest on Discipline's damage and mana talents, and from 31 takes the Holy healing talents. **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Blast** carry the fight, **Smite** fills the gaps while you have mana, and the wand does the rest. **Devouring Plague** joins at 20 and **Penance**, the spec's own spell, at 30. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Smite, until you own a wand
stages.change: **Smite** is your only attack. Buy or beg a wand as early as you can.
press: **Smite** while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
Your wand for the rest, once you own one. Until then, **Smite** to the end.
stages.if_hurt: **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health.
notes: Keep **Power Word: Fortitude** on yourself at all times, from here to 60.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Without one, every fight is **Smite** and you drink more often.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Pain
stages.change: **Shadow Word: Pain** opens every pull. The shield (6) and **Renew** (8) arrive for when a fight goes wrong.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Smite** in between, while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
Your wand for the rest.
stages.if_hurt: **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health.
notes: **Power Word: Shield** (6): before a pull only when you start it below 80% of your health. In melee, again below 80% once Weakened Soul has worn off, so hits do not push your casts back.
**Renew** (8): in a fight below 60% of your health, and after a fight below 85%: it heals while you loot and walk on.

stages.title: Mind Blast, and talents begin
stages.change: **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready. Talent points start with **Twin Disciplines**.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 10% of its health. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in between, while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
Your wand otherwise, and for the last hit or two.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you.
notes: **Twin Disciplines** (10-13) strengthens your instant spells: **Shadow Word: Pain** now, **Devouring Plague** from 20.
**Power in Light** (14) makes **Smite** a little stronger while your **Shadow Word: Pain** burns on the mob. **Mental Strength** (15-19): 10% more Intellect, so more mana.
**Psychic Scream** (14): when a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health, fear it and heal.
**Starshards** (10) is not part of this rotation.

Racial spells in the list above: Divine Grace (Human), Desperate Prayer (Dwarf), Starshards (Night Elf), Confounding Flash (Gnome), Touch of Weakness (Undead), Hex of Weakness (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Devouring Plague
stages.change: **Devouring Plague** follows **Shadow Word: Pain** on every pull. It heals you for the damage it does.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, then **Devouring Plague**; each again when it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 10% of its health. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in between, while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
Your wand otherwise, and for the last hit or two.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Flash Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
notes: **Flash Heal** (20) replaces **Lesser Heal** on your emergency key.
**Mental Agility** (20-21, 25) makes **Smite** and your instants cheaper. **Meditation** (22-24) keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast.
**Inner Focus** (26): press it as a pull starts, whenever it is ready. Your first spell is then free.
**Holy Fire** (20): leave it off your bar. The tuned rotation never casts it for this build.

Racial spells in the list above: Feedback (Human), Chastise (Dwarf), Elune's Grace (Night Elf), Contingency Plan (Gnome), Dark Sacrifice (Undead), Shadowguard (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Penance
stages.change: **Penance** (talent) whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 35% of its health: three Holy hits in 2 seconds.
press: As the pull starts: **Inner Focus** when it is ready. Your first spell is free.
**Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, then **Devouring Plague**; each again when it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Penance** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 35% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 10% of its health. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in between, while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
Your wand otherwise, and for the last hit or two.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Flash Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
notes: **Penance** is the spec's own spell. **Power in Light** makes it stronger too while **Shadow Word: Pain** burns.

From 31 the points go to the raid build's Holy talents. For you: **Twilight Focus** (31-33) keeps hits from pushing your casts back, **Holy Specialization** (35-39) adds crit to **Smite** and **Penance**, **Divine Fury** (40) shortens **Smite**, **Blessed Recovery** (41-42) heals you after a big hit, **Improved Healing** (48-50) makes **Penance** 15% cheaper and **Holy Precision** (56) adds hit.

**Improved Renew** (34), **Inspiration** (43-45), **Holy Reach** (46-47), **Litany of Light** (51-52), **Silent Resolve** (53-55), **Soul Warding** (57) and **Divine Aegis** (58-60) are for healing a group: they do little for a lone priest.

between: Drink only when you are below about 15% of your mana.
After a fight below 85% of your health, **Renew** yourself: it heals while you loot and walk on. Eat only if you are still below two thirds.
Recast **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** when they run out.
Visit the trainer every even level, and replace your wand whenever a better one turns up: it lands most of your hits.
other: Shadow levels fastest of the priest specs in the fight lab: the [Shadow guide](shadow-by-level.md). Level as Discipline if you want to heal dungeons on the way to 60.
The [Holy](holy-by-level.md) and [Smite](smite-by-level.md) guides play another list: a shield before every pull, **Holy Fire** to open and **Smite** at any mana.

Thumb: the damage over time, at the pull
The second damage over time, after Shadow Word: Pain
The panic heal, on a long cooldown (a Dwarf's spell)

notes: Same keys as the [Shadow guide](shadow-by-level.md) for every spell both play: **Smite** on Q, **Psychic Scream** on E, **Mind Blast** on R, **Power Word: Shield** on F, **Shadow Word: Pain** on Mouse 4, **Flash Heal** on 3, **Desperate Prayer** on 4, the wand on the middle mouse button, and the Shift bar's **Shackle Undead**, **Dispel Magic** and **Cure Disease**.

guides.intro: What a Holy priest presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. The build is the Holy raid healer's talents, taken in the order that levels fastest: Discipline's damage and mana talents first, the first Holy point at 32. The fight is a **Smite** priest's: a shield before every pull, **Holy Fire** to open from 20, **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** and, from 30, **Penance** whenever they are ready, and **Smite** in every gap. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Smite
stages.change: **Smite** is your attack, at any mana. A wand takes the last hit once you own one.
press: **Smite** until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Then your wand, once you own one. Until then, one more **Smite**.
stages.if_hurt: **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health.
notes: Keep **Power Word: Fortitude** on yourself at all times, from here to 60.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy or beg one as early as you can.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Pain, and the shield at 6

**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health.
notes: **Power Word: Shield** (6): cast it on yourself before every pull. While it holds, hits do not push your **Smite** back, so you can keep casting when the mob reaches you.
**Renew** (8): in a fight below 60% of your health, and after a fight below 85%: it heals while you loot and walk on.

stages.title: Mind Blast, and talents begin
stages.change: **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. Talent points start with **Twin Disciplines**.

**Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** again once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you.
notes: **Twin Disciplines** (10-14) strengthens your instant spells: **Shadow Word: Pain** now, **Penance** from 30.
**Mental Strength** (15-19) adds Intellect: a bigger mana pool.
**Psychic Scream** (14): when a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health, fear it and heal.
**Mind Blast** waits while you are below 30% of your mana, so the mana goes to **Smite** and, from 20, **Holy Fire**.

Racial spells in the list above: Divine Grace (Human), Desperate Prayer (Dwarf), Starshards (Night Elf), Confounding Flash (Gnome), Touch of Weakness (Undead), Hex of Weakness (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Holy Fire
stages.change: **Holy Fire** opens every pull from range: a hard hit and a burn for 10 seconds more.
press: Before the pull: **Power Word: Shield** on yourself.
Open with **Holy Fire** from range. Cast it again once its burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health; in melee only while your shield holds.
**Shadow Word: Pain** next, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** again once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Flash Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
notes: **Flash Heal** (20) replaces **Lesser Heal** on your emergency key.
**Meditation** (20-22) keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast.
**Inner Focus** (23): press it as the pull starts, whenever it is ready, right before **Holy Fire**. The opener is then free and more likely to crit.
**Silent Resolve** (27-29) cuts the threat your spells cause: nothing for a lone priest, it is the raid healer's point.
**Devouring Plague** (20): leave it off your bar. The tuned rotation never casts it for this build.

Racial spells in the list above: Feedback (Human), Chastise (Dwarf), Elune's Grace (Night Elf), Contingency Plan (Gnome), Dark Sacrifice (Undead), Shadowguard (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Penance
stages.change: **Penance** (talent) whenever it is ready: three Holy hits in 2 seconds.
press: Before the pull: **Power Word: Shield** on yourself. As the pull starts: **Inner Focus** when it is ready.
Open with **Holy Fire** from range. Cast it again once its burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health; in melee only while your shield holds.
**Shadow Word: Pain** next, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Penance** whenever it is ready.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.

**Holy Specialization** (35-39) adds crit to your Holy spells, and **Divine Fury** (44) takes a tenth of a second off the cast of **Smite** and **Holy Fire**. **Improved Healing** (49-51) makes **Penance** cheaper.
**Holy Nova** (42) is for pulls of several mobs: cast it only when two or more are within 10 yards of you.

The rest of the Holy points (**Improved Renew**, **Inspiration**, **Holy Binding**, **Litany of Light**, **Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing**) are for healing at 60. They do little for your kills, which is why this is a slow way to level.

Recast **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** when they run out.
Visit the trainer every even level, and replace your wand whenever a better one turns up: it takes the last hit of every fight.

No key: **Power Word: Fortitude**, **Inner Fire**, food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone. **Devouring Plague** and **Shadow Word: Death** are never cast by this rotation.

guides.intro: What a Smite priest presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. **Smite** and **Holy Fire** are your damage, carried by Discipline's talents, Holy's crit and cast speed and **Spirit Tap** from Shadow for mana. A shield before every pull keeps your casts from being pushed back, **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Blast** add damage, and the wand takes the last hit. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Smite
stages.change: **Smite** is your attack, at any mana. A wand takes the last hit once you own one.
press: **Smite** until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Then your wand, once you own one. Until then, one more **Smite**.
stages.if_hurt: **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health.
notes: Keep **Power Word: Fortitude** on yourself at all times, from here to 60.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy or beg one as early as you can.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Pain, and the shield at 6
stages.change: **Shadow Word: Pain** opens the pull. From 6, **Power Word: Shield** on yourself before every pull.
press: **Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health.
notes: **Power Word: Shield** (6): cast it on yourself before every pull. While it holds, hits do not push your **Smite** back, so you can keep casting when the mob reaches you.
**Renew** (8): in a fight below 60% of your health, and after a fight below 85%: it heals while you loot and walk on.

stages.title: Mind Blast, and talents begin
stages.change: **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. Talent points start with **Wand Specialization**.
press: Before the pull: **Power Word: Shield** on yourself.
**Shadow Word: Pain** to pull, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** again once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Lesser Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you.
notes: **Wand Specialization** (10-11) makes your wand hit harder.
**Power in Light** (14-18) makes **Smite** stronger while your **Shadow Word: Pain** burns on the mob, and from 20 while **Holy Fire** burns.
**Psychic Scream** (14): when a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health, fear it and heal.
**Mind Blast** waits while you are below 30% of your mana, so the mana goes to **Smite** and, from 20, **Holy Fire**.

Racial spells in the list above: Divine Grace (Human), Desperate Prayer (Dwarf), Starshards (Night Elf), Confounding Flash (Gnome), Touch of Weakness (Undead), Hex of Weakness (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Holy Fire
stages.change: **Holy Fire** opens every pull from range: a hard hit and a burn for 10 seconds more.
press: Before the pull: **Power Word: Shield** on yourself.
Open with **Holy Fire** from range. Cast it again once its burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health; in melee only while your shield holds.
**Shadow Word: Pain** next, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** again once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Flash Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
notes: **Flash Heal** (20) replaces **Lesser Heal** on your emergency key.
**Mental Agility** (20-21, 25) makes **Smite**, **Holy Fire** and your instants cheaper. **Meditation** (22-24) keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast.
**Devouring Plague** (20): leave it off your bar. The tuned rotation never casts it for this build.

Racial spells in the list above: Feedback (Human), Chastise (Dwarf), Elune's Grace (Night Elf), Contingency Plan (Gnome), Dark Sacrifice (Undead), Shadowguard (Troll). Only that race can learn its own.

stages.title: Inner Focus, then the damage talents
stages.change: **Inner Focus** (talent) as the pull starts: the opening **Holy Fire** is free and more likely to crit.
press: Before the pull: **Power Word: Shield** on yourself. As the pull starts: **Inner Focus** when it is ready.
Open with **Holy Fire** from range. Cast it again once its burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health; in melee only while your shield holds.
**Shadow Word: Pain** next, and again if it runs out while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana. It also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** in every gap, at any mana, until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit.
Your wand for the last hit.
stages.if_hurt: In melee below 80% of your health: **Power Word: Shield** again once Weakened Soul has worn off (below half at any time). **Flash Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
notes: **Soul Warding** (31) shortens the shield's cooldown and cost. **Twilight Focus** (37-39) keeps most hits from pushing your casts back once the shield breaks.
**Spirit Tap** (32-36) doubles your Spirit for 15 seconds after a kill, so you drink less.
**Holy Specialization** (42-46) adds crit to your Holy spells, **Divine Fury** (47-51) takes half a second off the cast of **Smite** and **Holy Fire**, and **Searing Light** (56-57) adds Holy damage.
**Holy Nova** (52) is for pulls of several mobs: cast it only when two or more are within 10 yards of you.
**Improved Shadow Word: Pain** (59-60) makes it last longer.
This build has no **Penance**. The [Holy guide](holy-by-level.md) keeps its key (Mouse 5); here it stays free.

between: Drink only when you are below about 15% of your mana.
After a fight below 85% of your health, **Renew** yourself: it heals while you loot and walk on. Eat if you are still below 80%.
Recast **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** when they run out.
Visit the trainer every even level, and replace your wand whenever a better one turns up: it takes the last hit of every fight.
other: Shadow levels fastest of the priest specs in the fight lab: the [Shadow guide](shadow-by-level.md).

The [Holy guide](holy-by-level.md) plays this same list on the Holy raid healer's talents, with **Penance**. The [Discipline guide](discipline-by-level.md) plays the Discipline list, with **Devouring Plague** and no **Holy Fire**.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; buffs, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the escape or the save, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand, the Shift bar the wider or rarer version of the key under it. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Every spell this guide shares with the Shadow guide sits on the same key, so you can switch specs without relearning. Setup: the [priest keybinds page](keybinds.md), written for Shadow.

slots.role: Control: fear what is on you
The shield: before every pull, and the save
Free: Penance's key in the Holy and Discipline guides; this build has none
Thumb: the damage over time, at the pull
The panic heal, on a long cooldown (a Dwarf's spell)

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift

slots.role: The area version of Q: two or more mobs in reach
Strip a mob's buff or your debuff
The heal over time, above the fast heal

notes: Same keys as the [Shadow guide](shadow-by-level.md) for every spell both play: **Smite** on Q, **Psychic Scream** on E, **Mind Blast** on R, **Power Word: Shield** on F, **Shadow Word: Pain** on Mouse 4, **Flash Heal** on 3, **Desperate Prayer** on 4, the wand on the middle mouse button, and the Shift bar's **Shackle Undead**, **Dispel Magic** and **Cure Disease**.

What moves: 1 holds **Inner Focus** (Shadow's **Vampiric Embrace**), 2 holds **Holy Fire**, 3 holds **Lesser Heal** until **Flash Heal** arrives at 20, **Renew** gets Shift+3 because this rotation casts it in a fight, and **Holy Nova** gets Shift+Q. Mouse 5 stays free: it is **Penance** in the Holy and Discipline guides and **Shadow Word: Death** in Shadow's, and this rotation casts neither.

The pull from 26: F, then 1, 2 and Mouse 4: **Power Word: Shield**, **Inner Focus**, **Holy Fire**, **Shadow Word: Pain**. **Inner Focus** is off the global cooldown, so **Holy Fire** follows at once.
One swap on bar 1: **Flash Heal** takes 3 at 20 and **Lesser Heal** leaves the bar. **Smite** stays on Q all the way.
4 holds **Desperate Prayer** only for a Dwarf: in Forever it is a Dwarf's spell, and the fight lab plays without racial spells. Other races leave 4 free.
C stays free for the healing potion macro on the [macros page](../macros.md).
No key: **Power Word: Fortitude**, **Inner Fire**, food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone. **Devouring Plague** and **Shadow Word: Death** are never cast by this rotation.
